pages.text: $(l)Royal Guard$(): your personal bodyguard. Needs Command research, the Soldier title and 32 emeralds. Guards follow and protect you, independent of town orders and alarms.$(br2)Villager Recruits' own professions are on the same page: $(l)Messenger$() and $(l)Scout$() (level 2), $(l)Siege Engineer$() (level 3, with siege weapons), $(l)Patrol Leader$() (level 5) and $(l)Captain$() (level 5, with Small Ships).
